onboarding.title: Murakaza neza, {{name}}!
onboarding.subtitle: Reka dushyiremo umutungo wawe wa mbere. Dore ibikurikiraho:

tenant.text: Ohereza buri mupangayi umurongo we bwite. Bazashobora kumenyekanisha ibibazo bakoresheje telefoni.

dashboard.vacantUnit: Iyi nzu irimo ubusa — tumira umupangayi
dashboard.emptyText: Tangira ushyiramo umutungo wawe wa mbere. Bifata umunota umwe gusa.
dashboard.emptyManager: Nta mutungo urahabwa gucunga. Saba nyir'umutungo akongeremo.

notifications.subtitle: Amakuru mashya ku mitungo yawe n'ibisanwa.

settings.subtitle: Hindura ururimi, ingano y'inyandiko n'amakuru ya konti.

tenant.joinedText: Nihagira icyangirika, kanda “Menyekanisha ikibazo”. Nyir'inzu azahita abimenya, kandi uzakurikirana gusana hano.
tenant.reportHint: Hari icyangiritse cyangwa kidakora? Bimenyeshe nyir'inzu mu ntambwe nke.
tenant.inspectionNote: Iyi ni inyandiko ifite itariki y'uko inzu yari imeze. Nubona hari ikitari cyo, bimenyeshe nyir'inzu.
tenant.paymentsNote: Ubu ni ubwishyu nyir'inzu yanditse. Nubona hari ikitari cyo, vugana na nyir'inzu.

landing.tagline: Gucunga inzu zikodeshwa mu buryo bworoshye
landing.badge: Byakorewe ba nyir'amazu bo mu Rwanda
landing.title: Kurikirana inzu ukodesha, ibisanwa n'ubukode — byose ahantu hamwe horoshye.
landing.subtitle: Rental_Control ibika amakuru y'uko buri nzu imeze, ifasha abapangayi kumenyekanisha ibibazo bakoresheje amafoto, kandi ikakwereka ubukode n'amafaranga yasohotse kuri buri mutungo.
landing.tenantNote: Uri umupangayi? Nyir'inzu azakoherereza umurongo w'ubutumire wawe bwite.

properties.title: Imitungo yawe yose
properties.text: Reba buri nzu, apartema n'umupangayi ku rupapuro rumwe.

passport.title: Pasiporo y'inzu y'ikoranabuhanga
passport.text: Amateka afite amatariki ya buri nzu: amasuzuma, amafoto, ibisanwa n'ibyo byatwaye.

repairs.title: Gusana nta guhamagarana
repairs.text: Abapangayi bamenyekanisha ibibazo mu gukanda gake. Ukurikirana buri gisanwa kuva gitangiye kugeza kirangiye.

photos.title: Amafoto nk'ibimenyetso
photos.text: Gereranya amafoto yo kwinjira n'ayo mu isuzuma rikurikiraho, ari iruhande rw'ayandi.

money.title: Ubukode n'amafaranga yasohotse
money.text: Andika ubukode wakiriye n'amafaranga wakoresheje, urebe icyo buri mutungo winjiza.

languages.title: Ururimi rwawe
languages.text: Koresha Rental_Control mu Cyongereza, Ikinyarwanda cyangwa Igifaransa.

help.title: Ubufasha
help.subtitle: Ibisubizo bigufi ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa. Kanda ku kibazo urebe igisubizo.

addProperty.a: Jya kuri “Imitungo yanjye” ukande “Ongeraho umutungo”. Kurikiza intambwe 4 ngufi. Hanyuma wongeremo buri nzu (apartema, inzu cyangwa icyumba) ukodesha.

inviteTenant.a: Fungura inzu ikodeshwa, uhitemo “Umupangayi”, ukande “Tumira umupangayi”. Andika amazina na imeyili by'umupangayi. Uzabona umurongo bwite: wohereze kuri imeyili, SMS cyangwa WhatsApp. Umupangayi awufungura agafungura konti ye.

reportProblem.a: Kanda kuri buto nini “Menyekanisha ikibazo”. Hitamo ubwoko bw'ikibazo, ugisobanure mu magambo make, ushyireho ifoto niba bishoboka, hanyuma ukande “Ohereza”. Uzahabwa nimero y'ikibazo.

trackRepair.a: Fungura “Ibyo nasabye” (abapangayi) cyangwa “Gusana” (ba nyir'inzu). Buri kibazo cyerekana aho kigeze n'amateka ya buri ntambwe: cyamenyekanishijwe, cyasuzumwe, gusana byatangiye, cyakemutse.

inspection.a: Isuzuma ni igenzura ry'inzu rifite itariki, icyumba ku kindi. Kuri buri kintu hitamo Ni byiza, Bikeneye kwitabwaho cyangwa Byangiritse, kandi ushyireho amafoto. Iyo urangije, inyandiko irafungwa kugira ngo izizerwe nyuma, urugero igihe umupangayi avuyemo.

rent.a: Jya kuri “Ubukode n'imari” ukande “Andika ubwishyu”. Rental_Control ibika inyandiko gusa — ntiyohereza cyangwa ngo yakire amafaranga.

language.a: Koresha “Ururimi” hejuru kuri buri paji. Icyo uhisemo kibikwa muri konti yawe.

textSize.a: Yego. Jya ku Igenamiterere (cyangwa Umwirondoro) uhitemo “Inyandiko nini”. Ushobora no gukoresha zoom ya mushakisha yawe.

help.contactText: Vugana n'itsinda rifasha rya Rental_Control. Dusubiza mu Cyongereza, Ikinyarwanda n'Igifaransa.

privacy.title: Amakuru ku buzima bwite
privacy.subtitle: Uko Rental_Control ikoresha amakuru yawe, mu magambo yoroshye.

what.title: Ibyo tubika
what.text: Amazina yawe, imeyili na nimero ya telefoni; imitungo n'inzu ucunga; amasuzuma, amafoto, ibibazo byo gusana, amafaranga yasohotse n'inyandiko z'ubukode wowe cyangwa abapangayi bawe mwashyizemo.

why.title: Impamvu tubibika
why.text: Ni ugukoresha serivisi gusa: kukwereka inyandiko zawe, kumenyesha abantu amakuru mashya, no kubika amateka yizewe ya buri nzu.

who.title: Ababibona
who.text: Ba nyir'inzu babona imitungo yabo gusa. Abacunga imitungo babona gusa iyo nyirayo yabahaye. Abapangayi babona inzu yabo gusa, ibibazo byabo n'inyandiko basangijwe. Umupangayi mushya ntashobora kubona ibibazo by'uwamubanjirije.

photos.title: Amafoto n'ibimenyetso
photos.text: Amafoto ni ibanga. Yerekwa gusa abantu binjiye bemerewe kubona iyo nyandiko. Amasuzuma yarangiye ntashobora guhindurwa, bityo agakomeza kwizerwa. Rental_Control ntijya ifata icyemezo cy'uwateje icyangiritse — ni abantu babyemeza.

rights.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
rights.text: Ushobora gukosora amakuru yawe mu Igenamiterere. Kugira ngo usibe konti yawe cyangwa ubone kopi y'amakuru yawe, vugana n'abafasha.

storage.title: Aho bibikwa
storage.text: Amakuru abikwa kuri seriveri zahiswemo n'ucunga iyi Rental_Control. Amagambobanga abikwa mu buryo burinzwe (bwahinduwe ntibusomeke).

notFound.title: Iyi paji ntiyabonetse
notFound.text: Iyi paji ntibaho cyangwa ntiwemerewe kuyibona.
